selectionOutcomes.description: Source-visible authorization branch: compares the resolved target user with the caller, permitting the self case without an administrator check and requiring administrator validation for a different target.
Accepted-policy comparison evidence for the different-member case: only an active administrator role passes the explicit administrator check.
Establishes the authenticated caller identity used by the handler's self-versus-different-member comparison.
Binds the requested target user and target membership to the resolved space and rejects a missing or inactive target membership.
Defines which membership roles count as active for the target-membership resolution used before the authorization branch.
Shows that, after the self/different-member authorization branch, deletion is applied to the resolved target membership and mutation errors are mapped.
Compares the resolved target user with the caller and requires administrator authority only for a different target.
Resolves the authenticated caller used by the self-versus-other comparison.
Binds the requested target user to the space membership and requires an active target membership.
Defines which membership roles count as active members.
Checks whether the caller membership has administrator authority for removal of another member.
Passes the resolved target membership identifiers and caller identity to the deletion operation.
Validates deletion identifiers and forwards the deletion request with the actor identity to the driver.
